recordedOnly.note: Re-measured after the live surface replaced the developer diagnostics tab. Two things moved, both deliberately. distinctComponents fell 60 to 57 because the deleted tab's components no longer exist. A quiet window now costs ZERO component renders, against 8970-10350 before: the previous figure was the raw snapshot push landing in state above the planning tree, and that push and its IPC channel are gone. A one-hero change costs 135 renders against 2343-2619, because the whole-tree rebuild that a snapshot arrival used to trigger no longer happens. The old ranges were wide because that background churn was not phase-locked to the measurement window; with it removed these are stable, and three consecutive local runs from fresh builds produced 0/135/57 every time. The ranges below keep a small margin for a slower CI machine rather than pinning exact values.
